statuses.checked: A verifier, here or upstream, computes it, and optifab uses the result.
statuses.designed: An upstream certificate or design covers it. Its role in the unit is not checked.
statuses.tested_code: Code that runs and is tested upstream. Not connected to a plant.
statuses.research: Studies with recorded results. No link to the plant yet.
statuses.specified: A specification or schema exists. Nothing is connected.
statuses.in_progress: Work is under way upstream and is not finished.
statuses.rule: A rule or scale in force that the unit follows.
statuses.idea: Vision or idea only. Nothing runnable or certified.

elements.element: Thermal budget: PCM skids holding 2,500 kWh_th
elements.note: The budget the gate spends.

elements.element: Heat sinks: aquifer loop, 200 energy piles, sky-cooling roof
elements.note: The certificate gives their heat flows but no recooling temperature, which finding 2 needs.

elements.element: High-temperature store: crushed-basalt beds, 20 MWh_th
elements.note: Sized by literals in the upstream verifier. The contract does not use it.

elements.element: Floors: funicular cassettes for 313 psf racks
elements.note: Five limit states in the margin vector, including the tightest.

elements.element: Shell: roof vault, sandwich walls, seismic frame, isolation plinths
elements.note: Five limit states in the margin vector.

elements.element: CFRP truss ties and the strengthening baseline
elements.note: funi-frame names them. Their certificates cover a beam example, not this roof.

elements.element: Lattice theory that proportions the members
elements.note: A preprint and a claimed extension. Nothing downstream re-checks them.

elements.element: Liquid loop and sorption chiller
elements.note: The load floor and the recooling limit are derived here.

elements.element: Racks: 10 MW of IT load
elements.note: A design basis. No rack, chip or power train is modelled.

elements.element: Airflow sensing that powers itself
elements.note: Its power margin at low airflow is in the margin vector.

elements.element: Leak and bondline sensing by impedance
elements.where: floor ribs, beside the liquid headers
elements.note: funi-floors certifies the reactance shift on a leak. Nothing reads it into a frame.

elements.element: Rack vibration sensing
elements.note: The limit is certified at 0.0005 g. No sensor is designed.

elements.element: Coolant and recooling temperature sensing
elements.note: The plant model carries no temperature, and Weft's only temperature is a formula of CPU load.

elements.element: Plant frame: 16 floats in 64 bytes
elements.note: The byte layout of Weft's telemetry frame. Round trip tested here. The slot meanings are a proposal.

elements.element: Agent messages
elements.note: Compact formats with validators. Not connected to a plant.

elements.element: Parsers on the telemetry path
elements.note: Candidates at Proven Commons. None is verified.

elements.element: The gate
elements.where: at each controller and in the scheduler
elements.note: Weft's predicate, first written in the Terrafab documents as a fence for machines. It passes Weft's 15 vectors and runs here on plant numbers.

elements.element: A machine-checked proof of the gate and of the loop built on it
elements.note: formal/ proves eight theorems in Lean about an exact integer gate. The comparator accepts them under six kernels and Proven Commons bar items 2 to 6 pass. Item 1 is open: no reviewer has approved the specification, so it is not verified. Weft's own floating-point gate has no proof yet.

elements.element: The loop that changes hardware and software together
elements.note: Runs on a model of the plant. Every decision is made by the exact gate, recorded in a hash-chained ledger and replayed in Lean. No sensor, load or machine is involved.

elements.element: Adaptive models
elements.note: Runs and is tested. No power or energy has been measured.

elements.element: Agents that use and operate the campus
elements.note: Exo itself was not read in this pass.

elements.element: Model weights stored at a few bits each
elements.note: Fewer bits per weight means less memory per model. No energy figure ties it to the plant.

elements.element: A chip that runs the net directly
elements.note: The chip of the Terrafab documents. Weft's audit calls it not testable as stated.

elements.element: Machines that make the structure's own parts under the gate
elements.note: The Terrafab loop. No machine is modelled. Process limits in the certificates, such as the Fe-SMA activation energy in funi-floors, could be its gate inputs.

elements.element: Certificates, pins and the lineage graph
elements.note: Every input is pinned to a commit, file and line.

elements.element: Signed commands and contributions
elements.note: Needed before any scheduler may command a plant. Weft's telemetry hash is unkeyed.

elements.element: Preferences are not permissions
elements.note: The gate can refuse a step. Only a person can authorise one.

elements.element: The evidence scale, and the rule that a person signs
elements.note: Used for every status in this repository.

elements.element: The bar for calling software verified
elements.note: The standard formal/ is built to, and the target for element W3.

elements.element: The group ethos: capture the work and pass it on
elements.note: The reason for HANDOFF.md.
